problem: float() coercion of bounds silently loses precision above 2**53, turns Fraction/Decimal/int bounds into floats, and changes union/intersection/difference results versus main.
float() raises OverflowError for ints beyond float range (e.g. 10**400) instead of the documented ValueError, and main accepted these inputs.
Decimal('1E+400') coerces to inf after validate_bounds has run, yielding a closed unbounded end that validation is meant to reject.
Production code now depends on the undeclared reference_impl copy via _ref._Algebra.parse(self, ...) without inheriting from it, while keeping ~140 lines duplicated from that module.
The branch adds no tests covering the changed numeric behavior (large ints, Fraction, Decimal, huge ints).
NaN bounds pass validation and break sorting and merging; this is unchanged from main.
